name: Mystery of the Murderous Dreams
source:
A series of unfortunate events has forced you to move back to the countryside where you spent your childhood. Sadly, you don’t have many memories of the time you spent there. Things aren’t all bad, though - Chinatsu and Chifuyu, two adorable sisters at your new school are glad to have you! However, Chinatsu mentions an urban legend of “Ichika’s Mansion,” a supposedly cursed old mansion at the edge of town. You don’t think too much about it, but on the bus home, you have a terrifying dream…

You’re still on the bus… but each of the passengers is labeled with a way of dying and when the bus stops, the first passenger in line is murdered in the way their label states! You wake up thinking it was just a dream, but you hear news of a boy in your school being murdered last night. You take a look at a photo of him and… It’s the boy that was murdered in your dream! It doesn’t take long to realize that this isn’t just a nightmare. Every time you ride the bus, another passenger is murdered and your turn is coming up soon!

Chinatsu and Chifuyu, along with their older sister, Chiharu, explain to you that this is all part of Ichika’s Curse. Anyone who enters the mansion will be cursed by her spirit. But how could you be cursed if you’ve never been to the mansion? It seems Chiharu knows more about your past that she’s willing to disclose...

Will you be able to stop the curse before it’s your turn? Will you be able to unlock the secrets of your past? Will you discover who Ichika truly is?

[from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.yumesatsujin&hl=en]Play Store[/url]]
translation:
接二连三的不幸，迫使你搬回童年生活过的乡间。遗憾的是，你对当年在这里的生活并没有多少记忆。不过，事情也不全是坏的。新学校里可爱的姐妹Chinatsu与Chifuyu，都很欢迎你的到来！然而，Chinatsu提起了一个关于“Ichika宅邸”的都市传说。据说，镇边那座古老宅邸受到了诅咒。你没怎么放在心上，却在回家的公交车上做了个可怕的梦……

你仍在公交车上……可每位乘客身上，都标着一种死法。车子一停，排在最前面的乘客就以标注的方式被杀！醒来后，你以为那只是梦，却听说学校里有个男生昨夜遇害。你看了他的照片……竟然就是梦中被杀的男孩！你很快意识到，这绝不只是一场噩梦。每次乘坐公交车，都会再有一位乘客遇害，而下一个就快轮到你！

Chinatsu、Chifuyu和她们的姐姐Chiharu向你解释，这一切都源自Ichika的诅咒。任何进入宅邸的人，都会被她的亡灵诅咒。可你从没去过那里，为什么也会中咒？Chiharu似乎知道你过去的事，却不愿全盘道出……

你能在轮到自己之前终结诅咒吗？能解开过去的秘密吗？又能否查明Ichika究竟是谁？

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.yumesatsujin&hl=en]Play商店[/url]]
